descStruct.summary: **慣性決定力版の太陽・地球・月 —— 8.85 年を再現するための初期配置と計算の見直し**(第297便b・原仮定者の裁定〔第87報〕・統括の検証項目 R162)。係数移送版(親 —— 第298便b で退役・宣言は 1 字も変えていない)の写しで、**初期配置の点検**の結果を直した派生本。係数移送版(と 🔆)は月の離心率 0.0549(平均要素 —— NASA NSSDC・JPL SSD は 0.0554)を t=0 の接触要素(近地点を太陽の反対方向に置いた)として置いており、走行の平均離心率は 0.0375 だった(太陽摂動〔出差〕の分だけ接触値と平均がずれる)。この本は地球–月の重心の位置・速度を保ち(丸めの差は速度で 1 ulp)、地球→月の相対ベクトルだけを、118 公転・h・gain 0 の走行の平均で**離心率 0.0549 と恒星月 27.321661 日(Chapront 2002)**を満たす (近地点距離 3.570492, t=0 の接触離心率 0.075566) に置き直した(2 元の Newton —— 入力の見直しであって法則の予言ではない)。physics は係数移送版の写し(重力 E4 と慣性引きずり)に λ_PN=0(原仮定者の裁定〔第87報〕)と gain 0。**gain の探索**(生成器 tests/exp-w297b-fit.mjs —— SI で 10⁻⁶〜0.0514182 m³/kg の対数格子+0・h と h/2): 118 公転窓の近点周期は gain 0 で 8.7873 年・移送 gain で 4.2598 年と単調に短くなり、標的 8.85 年は格子の全点で片側 —— **この探索範囲では未達 —— 次の見直しへ**。本の gain は探索範囲で標的に最も近い点(境界 0)。抽出器 3 方式(近点の方位・離心ベクトル・位相の回帰)の 118 公転窓は 8.7873/8.7665/8.5138 年・354 公転窓は 8.7681/8.7650/8.7368 年。太陽の位相 φ=0/90/180/270° で同じ平均要素に合わせ直すと 118 公転窓は 8.7873/8.7522/8.7836/8.7549 年。**次に疑う実装は 2 次元の射影**: 器の中だけの 3 次元のニュートンの参照積分器(アプリの物理ではない)は平面で 8.7650 年(本のエンジンとの差 8.9e-7)・月の軌道傾斜 5.145° を入れると 8.8643 年(+1.13%)。記録は fitRecord(説明タブの「フィットの記録」—— 条件の署名つき)。
descStruct.observe: トレイルとゴースト楕円(点線=初期・橙=歳差×20)で、月の近点の向きが順行に回るのを見る(係数移送版より離心率が大きい —— 平均 0.0549)。カメラは地球追従・視野 ±10 単位。数は説明タブの「フィットの記録」(条件の署名の行 —— 編集すると「以前の条件でのフィット(未再測定)」になる)。
descStruct.control: ワンタップの対照は移送した gain 51.4182(係数移送版の宣言値 —— 118 公転窓 4.2598 年)。初期配置を直していない係数移送版(第298便b で退役)は gain 0 の 118 公転窓で 8.7779 年。速度の規約 v=(I+L)W の対照(移送 gain・直した初期配置)は器の中だけ(118 公転窓 4.3196 年 —— v=W は 4.2598 年)。地球の公転離心率 0.01671123 の対照は 8.7883 年(本の宣言は円のまま)。

descStruct.summary: THE INERTIAL-DETERMINACY SUN, EARTH AND MOON - REVISING THE INITIAL CONFIGURATION AND THE CALCULATION TO REPRODUCE 8.85 YR (wave 297b; the originator's ruling in report 87; the coordinator's check item R162). A copy of the coefficient-transfer build (the parent, retired in wave 298b; its declaration is unchanged) with the result of the INITIAL-CONFIGURATION AUDIT applied. The coefficient-transfer build (and 🔆) place the Moon's eccentricity 0.0549 (a mean element - NASA NSSDC; JPL SSD gives 0.0554) as the osculating value at t=0 (perigee on the anti-Sun side), and the run's mean eccentricity was 0.0375 (the osculating and mean values differ by the solar perturbation, the evection). This sample keeps the Earth-Moon barycentre position and velocity (rounding differences of 1 ulp in the velocity) and re-places only the Earth-to-Moon relative vector at (perigee distance 3.570492, osculating eccentricity at t=0 0.075566), which satisfies ECCENTRICITY 0.0549 AND SIDEREAL MONTH 27.321661 D (Chapront 2002) as averages over a 118-orbit run at h with gain 0 (a two-variable Newton - an input revision, not a prediction of the law). physics is the coefficient-transfer build's copy with lambda_PN=0 (the originator's ruling in report 87) and gain 0. THE GAIN SEARCH (generator tests/exp-w297b-fit.mjs - log grid 1e-6 to 0.0514182 m^3/kg in SI plus 0, h and h/2): the 118-orbit apsidal period falls monotonically from 8.7873 yr at gain 0 to 4.2598 yr at the transferred gain, and the 8.85-yr target stays on one side of every grid point - NOT YET REACHED IN THIS SEARCH RANGE; CARRIED TO THE NEXT REVISION. The sample's gain is the point of the search range nearest the target (the boundary 0). The three extractors (apse direction, eccentricity vector, phase regression) give 8.7873/8.7665/8.5138 yr over 118 orbits and 8.7681/8.7650/8.7368 yr over 354 orbits. Re-matching the same mean elements at solar phase phi = 0/90/180/270 deg gives 8.7873/8.7522/8.7836/8.7549 yr over 118 orbits. THE IMPLEMENTATION TO REVISIT NEXT IS THE TWO-DIMENSIONAL PROJECTION: a three-dimensional Newtonian reference integrator inside the harness only (not the app's physics) gives 8.7650 yr in the plane (8.9e-7 from the sample's engine) and 8.8643 yr with the Moon's orbital inclination 5.145 deg (+1.13%). The record is fitRecord (the "fit record" card of the explanation tab - with a condition signature).
descStruct.observe: Use the trail and the ghost ellipses (dotted = initial, amber = precession x20) to watch the Moon's apse line turn prograde (a larger eccentricity than the coefficient-transfer build - mean 0.0549). The camera follows the Earth with a +/-10-unit field. The numbers are in the "fit record" card of the explanation tab (the condition-signature row turns to "fitted under earlier conditions" after an edit).
descStruct.control: The one-tap control is the transferred gain 51.4182 (the coefficient-transfer build's declaration - 4.2598 yr over 118 orbits). Without the revised initial configuration the coefficient-transfer build (retired in wave 298b) gives 8.7779 yr over 118 orbits at gain 0. The velocity-convention control v = (I+L)W (transferred gain, revised configuration) runs inside the harness only (4.3196 yr over 118 orbits; v = W gives 4.2598 yr). The control with the Earth's orbital eccentricity 0.01671123 gives 8.7883 yr (the declaration keeps the circle).

descStruct.summary: **慣性決定力版の地球と月**(第292便c・原仮定者の裁定〔第82報〕⑤⑥・統括の検証項目 R139)。🌙 earthMoonReal の実単位の地球と月(質量・半径・離角・速度・自転 —— 1 字も変えない写し)を、重力(E4)と**慣性引きずり**(physics.relativeDrag.law:"inertial" —— 第293便g から既定の合成則 solve: 力学速度 v の差 s_i=C_d Σ_j m_j 𝒦_j(r)(v_j−v_i) から (I+L)u=s を解き、位置だけを x+=u·dt で動かす。旧加算 u_i=Σ_j a_ij(V_j−V_i)〔V は座標の差分の移動ベクトル〕は compose:"sum" の明示だけ)だけで回す。geoPN=3(慣性決定力の有効化の印 —— 測地線 OFF・1PN なし)・kFrame=0(1PN も E6′ の q 引きずりも使わない —— 第294便a で geoPN=0 から 3 へ。力学はビット同一)。地球には**構造核** dragCore:{massFrac:0.325, radius:3.48}(一様密度のコア+マントル殻 —— 感度実験の起点の宣言で、地球の核の同定ではない)を宣言し、核 K_ε(s)=s/(s²+ε²)² を地球の質量分布で体積平均した ⟨K⟩(r) を地球を源とする対に使う(月は点源・受け手は点・自転は読まない)。**gain(C_d)=514182 は、近点回転の周期(検出器 B・27 公転窓)を 8.85 年に合わせた 1 次元フィットの推定**であって較正の合ではない(AN117 と同じ扱い)。8 公転窓の Δϖ は 0.053207 rad/公転(🌘 の較正窓 +0.05308 の 1.0024 倍)で、8 公転・27 公転・118 公転の窓で近点周期が変わらない(二体の性質)。構造核の効きは月の距離(a≈57R)で ⟨K⟩/K−1 ≈ ⟨ρ²⟩/a² ≈ 1.6×10⁻⁴ と小さく、点源で同じフィットをすると gain が 2.4e-4 大きくなるだけである —— **8.85 年の 1 量から C_d・f・R_c を同時に一意決定することはできない**(1 次の効きは質量分布の 2 次モーメント ⟨ρ²⟩〔慣性モーメント〕だけを通して入る。総質量と慣性モーメントを独立に固定して残る係数をフィットする順序が要る)。初速は 🌙 のまま合わせていないので恒星月は 27.143 日(-0.66% —— 118 公転の区間平均)。実際の月の近点回転の主因は太陽摂動であり(🔆)、本サンプルは太陽を入れない二体の原理サンプルである。

descStruct.summary: THE INERTIAL-DETERMINACY VERSION OF THE EARTH AND MOON (wave 292c; the originator's ruling in report 82 items 5 and 6; the coordinator's check item R139). 🌙 earthMoonReal's real-unit Earth and Moon (masses, radii, separation, speeds and spins copied without a single change) run under gravity (E4) and the INERTIAL DRAG alone (physics.relativeDrag.law:"inertial": from wave 293g the default composition rule solve takes the dynamical-velocity differences s_i = C_d sum_j m_j K_j(r)(v_j - v_i), solves (I+L)u = s and moves positions only, x += u dt; the former sum u_i = sum_j a_ij(V_j - V_i) over the coordinate-difference movement V runs only when compose:"sum" is declared). geoPN=3 (the mark for enabling the inertial-determinacy drag - geodesic off, no 1PN), kFrame=0 (no 1PN, no E6' q dragging - moved from geoPN=0 to 3 in wave 294a; the dynamics is bit-identical). The Earth declares a STRUCTURE CORE dragCore:{massFrac:0.325, radius:3.48} (a uniform core plus a uniform mantle shell - the starting point of a sensitivity experiment, not an identification of the Earth's core); the kernel K_eps(s)=s/(s^2+eps^2)^2 averaged over the Earth's mass distribution, <K>(r), is used for the pairs whose source is the Earth (the Moon is a point; receivers are points; spins are not read). THE GAIN C_d=514182 IS AN ESTIMATE FROM A ONE-DIMENSIONAL FIT of the apsidal period (detector B, 27-orbit window) to 8.85 yr, not a calibration agreement (treated as AN117). The 8-orbit advance is 0.053207 rad/orbit (1.0024 x 🌘's calibration-window +0.05308), and the period is the same in the 8-, 27- and 118-orbit windows (a two-body property). The structure core acts weakly at the Moon's distance (a ~ 57R): <K>/K - 1 ~ <rho^2>/a^2 ~ 1.6e-4, and the same fit with a point source needs a gain only 2.4e-4 larger - C_d, f AND R_c CANNOT BE FIXED TOGETHER FROM THE ONE 8.85-YEAR NUMBER (to first order the structure enters only through the second moment <rho^2>, i.e. the moment of inertia; the total mass and the moment of inertia must be fixed independently before the remaining coefficient is fitted). The speeds are 🌙's and are not refitted, so the sidereal month is 27.143 d (-0.66%, the 118-orbit mean). The real Moon's apsidal cycle is driven mainly by the Sun (🔆); this is a two-body principle sample without the Sun.
descStruct.observe: Use the trail and the ghost ellipses (dotted = initial, amber = precession x20) to watch the Moon's apse line turn prograde by about 3.05 deg per orbit (one cycle in 8.85 yr ~ 118 orbits). The apsidal period per 27 orbits is 8.850/8.850/8.850/8.850 yr and the eccentricity proxy 0.0490 in all four: lengthening the window changes nothing (the q dragging with kFrame=1, D₀=0.006 and qLock slowed to 20.8 yr and pumped the eccentricity). The HUD time is shown in days and years.
descStruct.control: Compare with 🌙 (same initial state, no inertial drag - the apses stay still) and 🌘 (kFrame=1 q dragging, a joint fit of D0 and the speeds). The structure-core sensitivity (f in {0.125, 0.325, 0.6} x R_c in {0.4, 0.546, 0.7}R and a point source) and the fit procedure are in tests/exp-w292c-dragcore.mjs, tests/out/dragcore-w292c.json and docs/PHYSICS.md (wave 292c).
descStruct.brief: Fit the inertial-drag gain to the 8.85-yr apsidal cycle; measure the core's effect. Met: solve default; gain = 1-D fit estimate; steady 118 orbits; core via <rho^2> at 1e-4. Out of calibration scope.

descStruct.summary: A DIAGNOSTIC THAT RUNS EXPLICIT TIDES (CONSTANT TIME LAG, CTL) ONLY IN A SAMPLE THAT DECLARES THEM (wave 292d, the originator's ruling in report 82 item 7, the coordinator's check item R140). 🌙 earthMoonReal's real Earth and Moon are copied without changing a character, with tide:{k2:0.3, lag:6} on the Earth and tide:{k2:0.024, lag:6} on the Moon (lag=6 units = 600 s is a declared starting point for sensitivity runs, not an identification of the real Earth, and not tuned to the lunar recession rate). Tides are kept in three separate meanings: (1) the external tidal tensor (a system resolved into particles already has it through pair gravity - and the declaration-only physics.backgroundTidal is a different key), (2) conservative deformation (the induced quadrupole of Love number k2, U=-B/(2r^6)), (3) dissipation (orbit-spin angular-momentum exchange and heat through the lag). The orbit runs on gravity (E4) and kF0's 1PN as in 🌙; the sample adds (2) and (3) per receiver (a body that declares a physical radius and k2) and updates the spin through its angular momentum J=I Omega, then Omega=J/I. Many-particle samples (more than maxN 8 particles, groups, shape toys, optical-camouflage dwarfs) get no explicit tide (an optimisation that avoids double counting). This sample declares NO inertial dragging (relativeDrag); the cross term with dragging is measured inside the harness with temporary presets.
descStruct.observe: It looks the same as 🌙 (the tidal force is about 1e-11 of gravity, invisible on screen, as it should be). Read the ledger instead: the Earth's spin slows by about 1e-11 of itself per sidereal month and that angular momentum moves into the lunar orbit (the exchange residual is at the rounding floor). The heat is positive, and work plus heat sums to zero at the rounding floor. Values are in tests/out/tide-w292d.json.
descStruct.control: The control is 🌙 earthMoonReal (no tides - same bodies, same physics). In the harness, setting the lag to 0 removes the dissipative torque and heat and leaves only the conservative deformation.
